E0.meaning: offline protocol, controlled numerical computation, persistence and isolation

E1.meaning: real model mathematical and teaching quality with response-bound human reviews

E2.meaning: automated browser functionality and consented human task usability kept separate

E3.meaning: independent transfer and delayed tests without reference help

routing_adapter.change: PolicyRouter receives a typed routing fixture instead of verifier JSON
routing_adapter.policy: use original fast-route fallback intent, no question ID or gold lookup

private_pair.changed_factor: selected personal context only; derived source IDs/hash recorded
private_pair.resource_policy: equal caps, no automatic retries; actual input token difference caused by context is reported, never called equal actual usage
private_pair.prompt_projection: remove personal_context, personal:* source index entries and derived source_hash; remaining full model inputs must match
private_pair.fixture_reply_policy: same neutral fixture body in both arms; no simulated improvement score

required: currency and verified all-billable-items cost upper bound
live_admission.policy: missing admission means zero provider requests; quality/usage/cost remain null

expand_only_if: reviewed material and authorized comparable live pairs
no unresolved severe evidence overclaim or memory contamination
human task completion and independent transfer evidence
